name: orion
description: Orion — Stremio-protocol catalog client that streams into VLC

scripts.dev:electron: wait-on http://localhost:5173 && cross-env ELECTRON_START_URL=http://localhost:5173 npm run start --prefix electron
scripts.start: npm run build:frontend && npm run start --prefix electron
scripts.dist: npm run build:frontend && npm run build --prefix electron
scripts.install:all: npm run install:frontend && npm run install:electron
